
{{alias}}( order, trans, N, NRHS, alpha, DL, D, DU, X, LDX, beta, B, LDB )
    Performs a matrix-matrix product of the form `B := alpha*A*X + beta*B`
    where `A` is a tridiagonal matrix.

    Indexing is relative to the first index. To introduce an offset, use
    typed array views.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string
        Row-major (C-style) or column-major (Fortran-style) order. Must be
        either `'row-major'` or `'column-major'`.

    trans: string
        Specifies the operation applied to `A`. Must be one of
        `'no-transpose'`, `'transpose'`, or `'conjugate-transpose'`.

    N: integer
        Order of the tridiagonal matrix `A`.

    NRHS: integer
        Number of right hand sides (columns of `X` and `B`).

    alpha: number
        Scalar `alpha`. Must be `0`, `1`, or `-1`; otherwise, it is assumed
        to be `0`.

    DL: Float64Array
        Sub-diagonal elements of `A`. Should have `N-1` indexed elements.

    D: Float64Array
        Diagonal elements of `A`. Should have `N` indexed elements.

    DU: Float64Array
        Super-diagonal elements of `A`. Should have `N-1` indexed elements.

    X: Float64Array
        Input matrix `X`. Should be an `N` by `NRHS` matrix.

    LDX: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `X` (a.k.a., leading dimension of the
        matrix `X`). Must be at least `max(1,NRHS)` when `order` is
        `'row-major'` and at least `max(1,N)` when `order` is `'column-major'`.

    beta: number
        Scalar `beta`. Must be `0`, `1`, or `-1`; otherwise, it is assumed
        to be `1`.

    B: Float64Array
        Input/output matrix `B`. Should be an `N` by `NRHS` matrix.

    LDB: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `B` (a.k.a., leading dimension of the
        matrix `B`). Must be at least `max(1,NRHS)` when `order` is
        `'row-major'` and at least `max(1,N)` when `order` is `'column-major'`.

    Returns
    -------
    B: Float64Array
        Output matrix.

    Examples
    --------
    > var DL = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var D = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ] );
    > var DU = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var X = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var B = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ] );
    > var ord = 'column-major';
    > var tr = 'no-transpose';
    > {{alias}}( ord, tr, 3, 1, 1.0, DL, D, DU, X, 3, 0.0, B, 3 )
    <Float64Array>[ 3.0, 5.0, 5.0 ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( trans, N, NRHS, alpha, DL, sdl, odl, D, sd, od, DU, sdu, odu, X, sx1, sx2, ox, beta, B, sb1, sb2, ob )
    Performs a matrix-matrix product of the form `B := alpha*A*X + beta*B`
    where `A` is a tridiagonal matrix, using alternative indexing semantics.

    While typed array views mandate a view offset based on the underlying
    buffer, the offset parameters support indexing semantics based on starting
    indices.

    Parameters
    ----------
    trans: string
        Specifies the operation applied to `A`. Must be one of
        `'no-transpose'`, `'transpose'`, or `'conjugate-transpose'`.

    N: integer
        Order of the tridiagonal matrix `A`.

    NRHS: integer
        Number of right hand sides.

    alpha: number
        Scalar `alpha`. Must be `0`, `1`, or `-1`; otherwise, it is assumed
        to be `0`.

    DL: Float64Array
        Sub-diagonal elements of `A`.

    sdl: integer
        Stride length for `DL`.

    odl: integer
        Starting index of `DL`.

    D: Float64Array
        Diagonal elements of `A`.

    sd: integer
        Stride length for `D`.

    od: integer
        Starting index of `D`.

    DU: Float64Array
        Super-diagonal elements of `A`.

    sdu: integer
        Stride length for `DU`.

    odu: integer
        Starting index of `DU`.

    X: Float64Array
        Input matrix `X`.

    sx1: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `X`.

    sx2: integer
        Stride of the second dimension of `X`.

    ox: integer
        Starting index for `X`.

    beta: number
        Scalar `beta`. Must be `0`, `1`, or `-1`; otherwise, it is assumed
        to be `1`.

    B: Float64Array
        Input/output matrix `B`.

    sb1: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `B`.

    sb2: integer
        Stride of the second dimension of `B`.

    ob: integer
        Starting index for `B`.

    Returns
    -------
    B: Float64Array
        Output matrix.

    Examples
    --------
    > var DL = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var D = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ] );
    > var DU = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var X = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var B = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 ] );
    > var tr = 'no-transpose';
    > {{alias}}.ndarray( tr, 3, 1, 1.0, DL,1,0, D,1,0, DU,1,0,
    ... X,1,3,0, 0.0, B,1,3,0 )
    <Float64Array>[ 3.0, 5.0, 5.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
